text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-runner` (INC-6331)
Alert: sustained queue backlog: queue_size=12,450, p95 latency=9.2s, oldest_item_age=5m
Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/inference/inference-runner?orgId=1&panel=queue
Tags: autoscaler, capacity, us-west-2

maria: acked — i'm oncall. tagging infra/autoscale owners @thomas @chris. i'll coordinate.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-6331 assigned to oncall (maria). Follow the autoscaler runbook for queue saturation.

thomas: looking now. autoscaler logs show repeated `provider_quota_exceeded` errors during scale attempts for ~22m. scale controller aggressive backoff kicked in. input rate steady ~380 req/s.

chris: checking cloud console — us-west-2 GPU quota shows 0 available; reserved pools hold the spare. emergency quota request queued, no approval yet. provider returned 403 on node create.

anna: quick mitigation options: (A) reroute non-critical traffic to another region, (B) enable CPU fallback workers for batched pipelines, (C) preempt low-priority reserved jobs to free GPUs, (D) enable short-circuit 429s for interactive endpoints. which should we prioritize?

maria: do (C) and (A) in parallel: evict low-priority reserved jobs to free some GPUs and start routing ~30% low-priority traffic to us-east-1. Thomas/Chris coordinate. I'll notify product-sre + CS.

thomas: applying routing change for low-priority paths now. engineer-bot, set weights: us-west=70 us-east=30 for /v1/generate?priority=low.

engineer-bot: proxy change applied.

chris: evicting non-critical reserved batch jobs (reservation ids: res-8812, res-8813, res-8816) — owners notified. starting manual scale in us-west once capacity shows up.

chris: provider accepted 6 new GPU instances after evictions. kube nodes are joining but a few pods still pending imagePull.

thomas: autoscaler patch: treat `provider_quota_exceeded` as a trigger to activate fallback pool instead of immediate backoff. quick config applied to allow cpu-fallback up to 40 replicas.

```
# autoscaler temporary config
fallback_on_quota: "true"
fallback_pool: "cpu-burst"
max_fallback_replicas: "40"
backoff_initial_seconds: "10"
```

thomas: patch rolled out. logs show controller switching to fallback.

maria: after routing + evictions + fallback, overall queue dropping: 12.4k -> 5.9k in ~8 minutes. p95 down to ~3.1s. interactive p95 still high for some customers.

anna: enabling circuit-breaker for interactive routes to fail fast for requests that would otherwise wait in queue >60s. applying rule now.

engineer-bot: circuit-breaker update applied for /v1/chat interactive routes. threshold queue-age=60s -> return 429.

chris: cloud team accepted a high-priority quota bump request for +10 GPUs in us-west; full approval ETA ~4h. we reprovisioned 4 GPUs immediately.

thomas: adjusted autoscaler backoff parameters to retry fallback sooner. also added a small reserved buffer config to prevent total consumption by long-running reservations. will follow up with PR.

maria: customer impact summary: no widespread 5xx spike; some interactive sessions experienced high latency and client retries. impact window ~25 minutes for affected sessions. CS alerted to prepare messages for impacted customers.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded (maria). Incident remains assigned.

anna: assigning post-incident owners: Thomas = autoscaler & fallback fixes, Chris = quota/reserved-pool policy, Maria = comms. I'll draft postmortem and runbook updates.

thomas: created PR for autoscaler fallback and lower backoff: https://git.redwood.local/autoscaler/pulls/418 (draft). includes handling for provider_quota_exceeded and smaller backoff windows.

chris: filing cloud change to adjust reserved pool floor and enable automatic preemption of low-priority reservations when queue > threshold (CR-8910).

maria: resolving PagerDuty alert now (manual resolve). keeping Slack thread open for handoff and PM notes. thanks all for fast action.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert state: mitigated. keep thread for postmortem notes and follow-ups.

anna: will monitor for 1h then close. follow-ups: update runbook to include traffic-split steps, auto-fallback on quota, preemption policy, and emergency quota playbook. assigning tasks on the incident board. handoff: maria -> anna in 10m. :coffee:
